docs.description: The International Financial Statistics database covers about 200 countries and areas, with some aggregates calculated for selected regions, plus some world totals. Topics covered include balance of payments, commodity prices, exchange rates,  fund position, government finance, industrial production, interest rates, international investment position, international liquidity, international transactions, labor statistics, money and banking, national accounts, population, prices, and real effective exchange rates.

docs.description: The Gold Barometer monthly gold buying-conditions scores, reconstructed point-in-time back to January 1971 using only data available at each date. The overall score and the part score of each measured component. Scores from 0 to 100. Zones: 0-19 historically very unfavorable, 20-39 unfavorable, 40-59 mixed, 60-79 favorable, 80-100 historically very favorable.
